# Do your captions read too fast, too crowded, or off-sync?

> Free tool: paste an SRT or WebVTT caption file and check it against commonly-used caption style-guide thresholds -- reading speed (characters per second), line length, lines per cue, minimum/maximum duration, overlapping cues, and too-short gaps between cues.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
